CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress Kerberos ports to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to Kerberos ports (TCP: 88, 464, 749, 750).
Risk: These ports handle Kerberos authentication (88), password changes (464), and admin (749-750). Attackers can intercept Kerberos tickets to perform pass-the-hash attacks, forge golden tickets for domain persistence, or brute-force service account credentials.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
